name: sinch-build-for-codex
description: Sinch Build skills and developer documentation for Codex: Conversation API (SMS, RCS, WhatsApp), Voice, Verification, Numbers, 10DLC, Fax, and Email

interface.longDescription: Bundles the Sinch Build skills catalog with the hosted Sinch Docs MCP server. Codex can search authoritative Sinch developer documentation and follow product guides for Conversation API (SMS, RCS, WhatsApp), Voice, Verification, Numbers, Number Lookup, 10DLC, Elastic SIP Trunking, Fax, Mailgun, Provisioning, and Authentication. Documentation search requires no credentials. Optional bundled scripts can call live Sinch APIs, such as sending a test message or managing webhooks, using your own Sinch credentials and only with your approval; these calls may incur charges.
defaultPrompt: Build an RCS rich card with images, buttons, and SMS fallback using the Sinch Conversation API.
Build an IVR phone menu with Sinch that routes callers to sales or support.
Help me add SMS OTP phone number verification to my app using Sinch
